WITH product_stats AS (
  SELECT pc.product_type_description,
         AVG(CAST(oi.product_quantity AS REAL)) AS avg_quantity,
         COUNT(*) AS order_item_count
  FROM Products p
  JOIN Product_Categories pc ON pc.production_type_code = p.production_type_code
  JOIN Order_Items oi ON oi.product_id = p.product_id
  GROUP BY p.product_id
),
product_shares AS (
  SELECT product_type_description,
         avg_quantity,
         order_item_count,
         CAST(order_item_count AS REAL) / SUM(order_item_count) OVER () AS order_item_share
  FROM product_stats
),
type_averages AS (
  SELECT product_type_description,
         AVG(avg_quantity) AS avg_quantity,
         AVG(order_item_count) AS avg_order_item_count,
         AVG(order_item_share) AS avg_order_item_share
  FROM product_shares
  GROUP BY product_type_description
)
SELECT AVG(avg_quantity) AS average_quantity,
       AVG(avg_order_item_count) AS average_order_item_count,
       AVG(avg_order_item_share) AS average_share
FROM type_averages
